choice: Two commands: git clone and install.sh, which checks macOS, a cmux terminal, the command line tools, Python 3.9+ and the cmux CLI, asks for the key, and sets up the Dock; after saving a key it runs dock-setup.sh --restart. uninstall.sh stops the helper first (only after ps and /api/state show it is the sidebar's server), closes its tabs and deletes the key; each step runs even if an earlier one failed. Updating is git pull plus scripts/dock-setup.sh --restart. The scripts share scripts/common.sh and fail with cmux's own message when a cmux command or the Dock parser fails.
context: The README must work for anyone without special knowledge.
rejected: Distributing a built app (needs a paid Developer ID and notarization); updating by Ctrl-C in the server tab and then dock-setup.sh (an extra manual step, and --new-key left the old key running); `eval "$(parser)"` (bash 3.2 does not stop on the parser's failure, so an unreadable tree looked like an empty Dock).
title: Install with git clone into ~/.cmux-linear-sidebar and install.sh
